new_defect_found.title: Sign-in lockout via remembered org — the VCST-5281 class resurfacing through a path the backend fix cannot reach

new_defect_found.detail: After using the org switcher the storefront REMEMBERS the selected org and sends it as an explicit organization_id on the NEXT sign-in, bypassing OrganizationAccessResolver entirely. If that org has since become blocked: HTTP 400, bounced to /sign-in, even though the user holds a healthy membership elsewhere (verified: implicit grant 200, explicit TechFlow 200, explicit BuildRight 400). HARD LOCKOUT — the only recovery is clearing site data, proved by a successful sign-in with the same credentials in a fresh isolated context. Reachable by ordinary use: switch org -> become blocked/re-invited there -> locked out. Error copy names a raw GUID, gives no org name and no recovery affordance.
new_defect_found.why_it_needs_a_product_decision_not_a_pa: The two plausible fixes conflict with an existing requirement. Either stop replaying a remembered organization_id on a password grant, or treat an explicit-but-inaccessible org on a PASSWORD grant as auto-resolved and fall through. But CUST-111 asserts an explicit blocked organization_id MUST be refused (and it passed), because silent substitution is exactly what CUST-112 fails on. 'Refuse explicit' and 'never lock the user out' are in genuine tension.
